game.name: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 is a football game for Xbox 360 that lets you choose from a variety of clubs and national teams to win the different competitions available. This sixth instalment in the PES series still features the Masters League mode, which pits you against the world's top clubs in four different pools. It is also possible to modify teams and players, as well as play in multiplayer.
